validity.segment_name: South Sioux City to Sioux Falls A-line Replacement Project
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED, INDEPENDENT OF GEM. FERC Docket PF19-8 (pre-filing, granted 2019-07-23) / CP20-487-000 (certificate application filed 2020-06-29) is the South Sioux City to Sioux Falls A-line Replacement Project, Northern Natural Gas Company, matching the sheet's SegmentName exactly. Confirmed via three Federal Register notices (Notice of Application, 2020-07-20, FR Doc 2020-15628; Notice of Schedule for Environmental Review, 2020-09-02, FR Doc 2020-19377; Notice of Availability of the EA, 2021-01-11, FR Doc 2021-00258, fetched via the govinfo PDF after the federalregister.gov HTML page returned a transient 500) plus the EIA Aug-2026 Natural Gas Pipeline Projects release (Historical Projects sheet, row 1171: Northern Natural Gas Co, docket PF19-8/CP20-487, NE/SD, 84 mi, 12 in, in-service 2024, status Completed). Two independent origins (FERC docket + EIA) -- high, independent. Project scope per the FERC filing: abandon-in-place ~79.21 mi of 14/16-in A-line (Dakota/Dixon Cos. NE, Lincoln/Union Cos. SD), replace with ~82.23 mi of new 12-in pipe in NE plus a 3.15-mi 12-in tie-over in Lincoln Co. SD (core 12-in total ~85.4 mi, vs the sheet's 84.00 mi -- agrees within ~1.6% rounding, and EIA's own Miles field reads exactly 84), plus a separate, smaller in-kind upgrade of the 0.16-mi 2-in Ponca branch to a 1.87-mi 3-in branch in Dixon Co. NE. The sheet's single Diameter=12 and LengthKnown=84.00 track the core A-line replacement (matching EIA exactly); the small 3-in Ponca branch is a distinct, minor feature that neither EIA nor GEM folds into these fields -- consistent, not a defect, so no contested value proposed. PipelineType=transmission is correct: this is an NGA Section 7 interstate certificate proceeding (FERC-jurisdictional transmission, not gathering/distribution, which NGA 1(b) exempts); EIA's own pipeline_type field for this project reads 'Interstate' under authority 'FERC', agreeing. Fuel=Gas is trivially correct (NGA natural-gas facilities; EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects). DUPLICATE CHECK: compared against all 6 other 'Northern Natural Gas Pipeline' rows in this roster (P2578, P2603, P2734, P3942, P3943, P7772) by docket and project name -- none share this project's docket (PF19-8/CP20-487) or SegmentName; this is a distinct expansion/replacement project on the shared Northern Natural system, not a duplicate. Confirms the Delayed=yes/DelayType=confirmed flag: EIA's own release history shows this project stuck at 'Part Completed' continuously from the 2021-01 release through the 2025-04 release (~4.3 years) before finally reading 'Completed' in the 2025-07 release, well beyond the ~1-2 year window implied by the certificate timeline (EA issued 2021-01-11, FEIS/EA deadline 2021-04-05, certificate agenda item at the FERC Sunshine Act meeting of 2021-04-08) -- a real, multi-year completion delay, not a dormancy inference.
